record.kind: Inline check in PokemonEntity.onDeath (on an adjacent ally's death); no PassiveEffects entry
record.summary: Passive.LAST_RESPECTS has no PassiveEffects entry; its only reader is a block at the end of PokemonEntity.onDeath. When any entity dies (triggerDeath, hp <= 0 with no pending resurrection; the dying unit's team is reset to baseTeam first), every entity in the 8 cells around it (Board.getAdjacentCells, diagonals included, off-board cells skipped) that has passive LAST_RESPECTS and the same team as the dying unit gets addPP(p.maxPP - p.pp, p, 0, false). The requested amount is therefore 'up to maxPP': with pp below maxPP the request fills the bar exactly to maxPP (140 for both units), which then lets the unit cast (casting rules: section B/H of the core mechanics). The requested value is computed from the receiver's current pp at that moment and goes through addPP (section J3): fatigue halves a positive request (rounded), the gain is dropped when the unit is silenced, has status.protect (not Rune Protect), NO_PP_GAIN, or is resurrecting; so under fatigue only half of the missing PP is added. If pp is already above maxPP (the cap is 2 x maxPP - 1) the request is negative and the call lowers pp to maxPP (a negative value is not blocked by silence/protect, only by status.tree; Twist Band does not flip it because the caster is the unit itself, same team). The dying unit can be an ally of either kind (any unit), not only a LAST_RESPECTS unit, and its own passive does not trigger itself because the centre cell is excluded. The ability LAST_RESPECTS (curse + special damage) is a separate mechanism that shares only the name.
triggers: PokemonEntity.onDeath of any entity adjacent to the unit and on the unit's team (via triggerDeath)

effects.declaredRaw: addPP(maxPP - pp) to each adjacent same-team LAST_RESPECTS unit when a unit dies
effects.scaling: requested amount = maxPP - current pp, apBoost 0, no crit; fatigue halves a positive request (Math.round, so .5 rounds up)
effects.resolution: requested maxPP - pp; applied = that after fatigue rounding unless dropped by silence / status.protect / NO_PP_GAIN / resurrecting; the result is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1; a negative request (pp > maxPP) reduces pp to maxPP. Rune Protect alone blocks nothing here.

conditions: the unit is in one of the 8 cells adjacent to the dying entity
the unit's team equals the dying entity's team (after the dying entity's team is reset to baseTeam)
the death is processed by triggerDeath (a resurrecting unit does not die and does not trigger)
record.resetBehaviour: No state kept; each qualifying death triggers once per adjacent qualifying unit.
